title: Strategy atlas: event-level formula catalog, lifecycle, recurrence, complementarity and residual analysis
objective: Catalog every strategy in the registered and progressively expanded formula grammars, including one-target/retrospective explanatory rules, and evaluate each rule only with information available before each target whenever making an ex-ante claim.
non_goals: Do not claim the infinite universe of mathematical algorithms is exhausted.
Do not promote a strategy because it fits a target retrospectively.
Do not infer intent or agency from apparent randomness.
Do not overwrite or reconstruct immutable historical target freezes.

strategy_classes.description: Rule and parameters fixed without target outcome; evaluated chronologically.
Rule eligible only when prior-only state conditions are met.
Rule whose performance appears in separated time intervals; recurrence measured without assuming periodicity.
Rule that performs relatively better on targets or numbers missed by another rule.
Rule whose ranking is inversely associated with another rule's ranking; evaluate as a distinct candidate, not as evidence by itself.
Rule selected after observing a target or target-specific outcome; stored for explanation only and excluded from ex-ante performance claims.
Rule with null or worse-than-baseline results; retain for exclusion, contrast, and future conditional analyses.

relationship_analyses: canonicalize formulas and cluster algebraically equivalent/near-equivalent rules
pairwise rank correlation and top-k overlap
complementarity on other strategies' misses, using paired target comparisons
state-conditioned transitions and changes in relative strategy performance

chronology_and_validation.archive_cutoff: Use the latest verified canonical archive at run time; explicitly record its blob SHA and last date.
chronology_and_validation.ex_ante_rule: For target i, every feature and parameter must be computable from draws strictly earlier than i.
chronology_and_validation.thresholds: Fit on discovery only, freeze before validation and blind OOS.
chronology_and_validation.multiple_testing: Register the complete tested family before evaluating outcomes; use Holm-Bonferroni or an explicitly justified family-wise procedure.
nulls: conditional randomization preserving five distinct winning numbers per target
chronology_and_validation.freeze_policy: Append-only; never reconstruct missing freezes or overwrite prior target freezes.
chronology_and_validation.reporting: Separate descriptive fit, ex-ante walk-forward results, blind OOS, and prospective shadow results.

guardrail: Catalog breadth is not predictive evidence. Every strategy remains exploratory until its chronological and prospective acceptance criteria pass.
